title: The Black Echo
author: Michael Connelly
summary: A Los Angeles homicide detective with a Vietnam past is called to a body found in a drainage pipe, apparently another drug overdose. He recognises the dead man from the tunnels of the war, and a larger case opens up.
readIf: you like gritty, grounded police stories with a stubborn detective who refuses to let a case go.
skipIf: you want fast action throughout, because this is a careful procedural first and a thriller second.

pairings.reason: The classic Los Angeles private-eye novel that this modern detective ultimately descends from.
A brisker, more physical thriller with a loner hero and a corrupt small-town case.
A calmer, more character-driven detective story with a haunted lead.
